fullStory: ) Farm House was built next to St St Dochdwy’s Church, Llandough
1215-1539 - Owned by Tewkesbury Abbey / Prior of Cardiff (Ecclesiastical Title)
1539-43 - The Crown (Henry VIII) (Confiscated during the Dissolution)

1543-1770 -  following the Dissolution of the Monasteries (1543), the land passed through the Crown and was likely held by local gentry, including the suspected heirs of Sir Matthew Cradock, who held interests in Llandough as early as 1531
Heir primarily include the Herbert family
